neighbours.label: a lone 'w'/'V' letter token that begins a word the tokenizer splits (w|obble, w|iggles, w|icking, V|ulnerable)
fire: The bicycle wheel developed a slight wobble after the crash on the gravel road.
The puppy would wiggle its whole body whenever the children came home from school.
Good hiking socks use wicking fabric that pulls sweat away from the skin.
As the moon waxes toward full, the tides along the coast grow stronger.
The table on the wall wobbled every time a truck rumbled past the café.
The candle's wick was trimmed short so the flame would not smoke.
Scientists measured the tiny wobble in the planet's orbit over several years.
Climate wiggles from ocean cycles can hide a long-term warming trend.
quiet: The bicycle wheel developed a slight bend after the crash on the gravel road.
The puppy would shake its whole body whenever the children came home from school.
Good hiking socks use breathable fabric that pulls sweat away from the skin.
As the moon grows toward full, the tides along the coast grow stronger.
The table on the terrace shook every time a truck rumbled past the café.
The candle's thread was trimmed short so the flame would not smoke.
Scientists measured the tiny shift in the planet's orbit over several years.
Climate swings from ocean cycles can hide a long-term warming trend.

notes: Card: peaks are ' w', 'W', 'w', ' V' as the first piece of a split word (wiggles, wobble, wicking, waxes, VARIABILITY, Vulnerable). + pole is the V of vine/wine words and its output reverses vine/wine logits. Near misses use whole-token synonyms.
